simple.meaning: שָׂרַט (sâraṭ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to gash.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 3 times in Leviticus, Zechariah, beginning at Leviticus 21:5. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂרַט (H8295) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׂרַט (sâraṭ) / H8295 is traced through Leviticus 21:5, Zechariah 12:3 with source-language evidence and verse context.

occurrences.englishText: “ ‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
